prompts.readiness: How ready are we for a disruption? Look at our impact analyses, continuity plans, exercises and ICT readiness, and tell me the most important gaps to close first.
prompts.biaOverview: Which of our business impact analyses need attention, for example missing recovery targets, no covering plan or overdue reviews?
prompts.planOverview: Which continuity plans are weakest: not approved, overdue for review or never exercised? What should I do first?
prompts.exerciseOverview: Summarise our recent exercises and tests: outcomes, recovery targets met or missed, and open lessons learned.
prompts.summariseBia: Summarise this business impact analysis: the impacts, the recovery targets and anything that looks inconsistent or missing.
prompts.summarisePlan: Summarise this continuity plan and point out gaps against the recovery targets of the activities it covers.
prompts.summariseExercise: Summarise this exercise: what was tested, how it went and which follow-up actions are still needed.
prompts.ictGap: Explain the readiness of this ICT service and what we must change to meet what the business requires.
prompts.ictCapability: How do I determine the achievable recovery time and recovery point for an ICT service?
prompts.nextStep: What is the next step for this record in the approval and review process?
prompts.impacts: How do I rate the impact of a disruption over time for this activity?
prompts.targets: How do I choose a sensible MTPD, RTO and RPO for this activity?
prompts.activation: What makes good activation criteria for a continuity plan?

statusHelp.draft: Being prepared. Submit it for approval when it is ready.
statusHelp.in_review: Waiting for an approver to approve or reject it.
statusHelp.approved: Approved and in force. It is reviewed periodically.
statusHelp.retired: No longer in use. It is kept for the record.

actionHelp.submit: The approvers are notified and can approve or reject it.
actionHelp.approve: Approving makes this the version in force and schedules the next review.
actionHelp.reject: It goes back to draft. Explain what must change.
actionHelp.review: Confirms the content is still correct and sets the next review date.
actionHelp.retire: A retired record is no longer in use but stays in the history.
actionHelp.restore: Brings the record back as a draft.

actionDone.reject: {{ code }} was rejected and is back in draft.

readinessIssueHelp.rto_gap: The service takes longer to recover than the business can tolerate. Improve the recovery strategy or agree a longer RTO.
readinessIssueHelp.rpo_gap: More data could be lost than the business accepts. Back up or replicate more often.
readinessIssueHelp.rto_capability_unknown: Nobody has recorded how fast the service can be recovered. Find out, ideally by testing it.
readinessIssueHelp.rpo_capability_unknown: Nobody has recorded how much data could be lost. Check the backup or replication interval.
readinessIssueHelp.never_tested: Recovery has never been tested. Plan a recovery test.
readinessIssueHelp.test_overdue: The last test is older than the test cycle. Plan a new test.
readinessIssueHelp.last_test_failed: The last test did not succeed. Follow up the lessons learned and test again.
